title: The 7 Tools on Our AI Pentest Rig
description:
7 tools for black-box testing — attack the running app like a real attacker would. These are the ones we run on Kronos, our AI-driven pentest rig.

1. OWASP ZAP — the free DAST standard, start here → https://zaproxy.org
2. Nuclei — template-based scanning, blazing fast → https://github.com/projectdiscovery/nuclei
3. Burp Suite — the standard for manual testing → https://portswigger.net
4. sqlmap — SQL injection, fully automated → https://sqlmap.org
5. gobuster and ffuf — find the hidden endpoints
6. Metasploit — the exploitation framework → https://metasploit.com
7. Full Kali Linux — the whole arsenal, on demand → https://kali.org

Or drive it all with AI. An agent runs the toolset for you. That is AI-driven engineering.

📕 FREE web-book — Become the Cyber Security Expert the AI Era Demands:
https://app.stationx.net/book

Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/c/+StationxNet?sub_confirmation=1

Music: "The Beach (Original Mix)" by Astral, CC BY 3.0

⚠️ For authorised security testing only. These tools are shown for education and legitimate, permission-based penetration testing. CAI (Cybersecurity AI) is an open-source framework by Alias Robotics (MIT).

#cybersecurity #pentesting #dast #kali #ethicalhacking #aidrivenengineering #stationx
